name: Motor stalled-start trip interface
summary: Transfers detection of an unsuccessful acceleration condition to the feeder trip path.
description: Transfers detection of an unsuccessful acceleration condition to the feeder trip path. A motor feeder combines switching, motor protection and an operating command. Starting permission, running feedback and protection trip are different signals even where one relay or controller processes all of them.

In a switchroom motor-control panel, a ventilation motor can receive an automatic start request while a local selector and the motor protection determine whether the feeder is available. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Starting current and timing” at the input and “Stalled-start trip request” at the output. Thresholds require the selected motor protection study.
